brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Dozeline, the iOS and Android wind-down and sleep journal app in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: calm, warm, not clinical, no moons or stars cliché. The app icon must be recognisable on a home screen at small sizes. English and Turkish markets.

claim.notes: Only settling-line passed the gate (avg 6.54, marginal; still reads as a reclining figure and has a sub-pixel dot gap at 16px) and was finalized with the insufficient-evidence originality risk accepted, since no trademark registry was searched.

concepts.title: Ajar Light
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 broken shards (fail); s2 door/bottle silhouette; s3 ellipse with parallelogram (eye/pill/UI toggle); s4 d with misregistered stem (letter, glitchy); s5 L plus wedge (fail). Door and floor-light idea does not read at a glance; s4 is a stock letter with a slit. Different move: one bold light-wedge spilling from a gap, no letter, no door frame.

concepts.title: Lit d
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 d with play-button triangle counter; s2 lamp/bell/dome with post; s3 plain heavy bold d; s4 d cut by a stripe (glitch/clipped). No glow idea survives; s3 is just a stock letter, s1 triangle is a play button. Different move: drop the d letterform; make warmth from one non-letter shape (e.g. soft light spill) instead.

concepts.title: Settling Line
readsAs: person lying down with head resting on a bed
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 wave/heartbeat with dot; s2 squiggle with dot; s3 level line rising in one swell to a ball (lever/pulled thread); s4 caret+dot (fail); s5 d-hook (fail). Keep s3: one-colour, survives 16px, ownable gesture, warm round ends. Fix: tune the swell so it does not read as a chart step or joystick; make the line end softer and heavier, ball slightly smaller, optically balance the flat tail so the whole sits centred; keep stroke thick for 16px. Stay away from ECG/graph reading.
